entities.summary: Soma Quality Recordings is an independent record label based in Glasgow, Scotland. It was co-founded in 1991 by the electronic music duo Slam, Dave Clarke, and Glenn Gibbons. The label is known for releasing early works from Slam, Jeff Mills, and Funk D'Void, as well as tracks such as Silicone Soul's "Right On Right On", Felix da Housecat's "Clashback", and the original vinyl version of Daft Punk's "Da Funk".
